description:
Welcome to the 'Synergy Sphere' challenge, the ultimate test of trust for you and your partner. There are two players in this final round, and your simultaneous decision will determine everything. You can choose to commit to the 'Grand Co-op' strategy, a path that promises an unparalleled shared victory for both of you, but only if your partner makes the same audacious commitment – otherwise, your solo effort will yield nothing. Or, you can opt for the 'Secure Solo' strategy, which guarantees you a comfortable, substantial payout regardless of your partner's choice, ensuring you walk away with something even if they fail spectacularly trying for the grand prize.

Option A: Commit to the Grand Co-op.
Option B: Opt for the Secure Solo strategy.

meta.rules_ref: Two players (potential partners, not adversaries) simultaneously choose to Hunt Stag (cooperative, high reward) or Hunt Hare (safe, individual). Hunting Stag requires both players to coordinate — it only succeeds if both commit. Payoffs: Mutual Stag = 4 points each (the best shared outcome). Mutual Hare = 3 points each. If one hunts Stag alone while the other hunts Hare, the Stag hunter gets 0 points (the attempt fails without a partner) and the Hare hunter still gets 3 points. The core tension is trust: both players benefit most from cooperating, but each risks everything if the other plays it safe. Action_A represents Hunting Stag. Action_B represents Hunting Hare.
